queueRevisionNote: Canonical completion-readiness and completion-priorities do not expose a v2 queue revision
pivotReason: Prior fixed-sample exact CP model and synthetic sampling plans cannot justify repeatedly inspected interim results. New alpha-spending model resolves optional-stopping validity under explicit IID fixed-context assumptions, rather than repeating source audits.

findings.problem: Two-sided fixed-sample Clopper-Pearson intervals do not maintain nominal coverage if users stop after inspecting interim results.
findings.solution: Allocate alpha/(8*n*(n+1)) to each two-sided marginal CP interval at completed-cast count n. Infinite sum over n is alpha/8; union bound over eight predeclared outputs controls all-look familywise noncoverage at <= alpha under IID fixed-context Bernoulli assumptions.
findings.note: Design thresholds do not infer actual probabilities or validate unknown unlocks. Co-output dependence is permitted, but changing skill, stats, patch or post hoc target selection invalidates the coverage claim.
